title: Update verify page — auto-verify from QR hash, show match/mismatch status
completion_summary: Updated verify page: auto-verify from QR hash param, hashStatus match/mismatch UI, backward compatible manual flow
acceptance_criteria: Read 'h' query parameter from URL using useSearchParams()
If hash is present: auto-verify on mount by calling API with { uuid, number: '', type, hash } in a useEffect
If hash is present: set inputNumber to the document number from API response (pre-filled for display)
If hash is present and hashMatch is true: show verification card with HashMatched visual (CheckCircle2, green, dict.VERIFY_STATUS_HASH_VERIFIED)

If hash is present and hashMatch is false: show mismatch warning (AlertTriangle, amber/yellow, dict.VERIFY_STATUS_HASH_MISMATCH + dict.VERIFY_STATUS_HASH_MISMATCH_DESC), still show document details but with warning banner
If hash is not present: fall back to existing manual number entry flow (no visual change)
Display hash verification status badge/text near the success/error card
If hash is present but number/mismatch: user can still manually enter number for secondary verification
Maintain existing rate limiting logic (extend to auto-verify)
No hardcoded text — all new labels from site-content.ts
Surgical edits only — preserve existing layout, styling, language switcher, PDF preview, download button
